غَضْيَا : see غَضْيَآءُ. ―
-b2- Also, (K, TA,) determinate, and imperfectly decl., like [its syn.] هُنَيْدَةُ, (TA,) A hundred camels: (IAar, K, TA:) held by ISk to be so called as being likened to a place producing [an abundance of] غَضًا [i. e. the trees thus called]: AA has mentioned it with the article ال, saying that الغَضْيَا signifies a hundred. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
